sections.title: GM07 File Profiles
sections.text: Imports CSV/JSON samples into a selected native sketch as line or fitted-spline geometry. schemaVersion:1 and frame:sketch are required; plane:sketchXY declares the sketch-local frame. columns maps x/y/z or angle/radius source fields (profile_x is a coordinate, never a radius); optional loop and status columns. units:{length,angle?} are required; unit-bearing cells override. closed:true requires an explicit repeated first endpoint within tolerance; a missing chord is never invented. interpolation lines (default) or spline; closed splines set native periodic closure. winding cw/ccw requires closed nonzero-area loops. Samples are importedReference; re-import into a fresh sketch after source changes. Run with --preview for host-side file preflight without Fusion.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result has schemaVersion:1, success/status/operation/documentIdentity, units:{length:cm,angle:rad}, frame:{space:sketch,sketch:Ref}, associativity:importedReference, provenance with source path/SHA256/revision/status:DERIVED, entities:Ref[], sourceLoops, sampleMap with strokeDistance and upperBound, fitError:{status,maximumStrokeDistance,upperBound,tolerance}, profiles:[{kind:profile,sketch:Ref,index}] and inspection curves/loops/selfIntersections/cusps. fitError.status pass means the measured upper bound fits the requested tolerance; fail/unknown mark detection failure or an inconclusive fit. created contains the geometry entities; the profile is feedable to model.extrude.

sections.title: Safety And Limits
sections.text: 16 MiB source, default 2000/max 10000 input or native stroke points, default 10 s/max 120 s cooperative budget. Geometry is validated before the first sketch mutation, but kernel failures can still leave partial geometry; inspect before retry. Imported coordinates are not linked to the source file.

examples.label: Open cam profile from inline records
examples.requires: An existing sketch GM07_Profile in the selected component; create it with sketch create name GM07_Profile plane XY.
examples.output: result.entities are the fitted spline refs; result.fitError.status is pass when the measured bound fits the tolerance; reuse result.profiles for extrusion.

sections.title: GM07 Fit
sections.text: Same input contract as sketch.profile-file; the operation name differs only in the envelope. Fits native line or spline geometry to XY/XYZ/polar samples with an explicit tolerance; no radial substitution of a normal offset is ever offered.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: Identical to sketch.profile-file: schemaVersion:1 envelope, entities, sourceLoops, sampleMap, fitError, profiles and the bounded-stroke inspection. fitError.status pass means the fit is inside the requested tolerance including its reported uncertainty.

sections.title: Safety And Limits
sections.text: Shared budgets and preflight as sketch.profile-file. Deviation is sample-to-stroke distance with a documented bound, not exact nearest-point projection.

examples.label: Fitted polyline
examples.requires: An existing sketch Profile in the selected component.
examples.output: result.entities contains one line segment; fitError.status pass with a tight tolerance.

sections.title: GM07 Inspection
sections.text: Read-only bounded evaluator inspection of native sketch curves: entities are nonempty sketch curve refs in flow order. getStrokes supplies the documented deviation bound; 65 curvature/derivative samples per curve detect zero derivatives and signed curvature. No mutation, no created refs.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result has schemaVersion:1, status/operation/documentIdentity, units, frame:{space:sketch,sketch:Ref}, associativity:snapshot, inspection:{curves,loops,selfIntersections,cusps,strokeCount,strokeTolerance,polylines}, method and limitations. status pass means the sampled scan found no crossings, near contacts or cusps; unknown means curvature sampling was incomplete; fail means violations were detected. Pass is not a continuous regularity certificate.

sections.title: Safety And Limits
sections.text: Curvature extrema between samples, global self-contact and G0/G1/G2 join quality are not certified. Re-inspect after topology or parameter changes; nothing stores a future-topology rule.

examples.label: Inspect a profile
examples.requires: A real curve ref from sketch.inspect curves or the entities returned by sketch.profile-file; the example token is a placeholder, not an executable ID.
examples.output: result.inspection.curves/loops and result.status pass/unknown/fail; the report does not mutate the sketch.

sections.title: GM07 Normal Offset
sections.text: Offsets one connected native sketch loop by a positive distance with an explicit side (left/right of SDK flow; circles/ellipses flow CCW). Curvature-radius loss and cusp evidence block before mutation. The distance expression is retained in the native offset dimension; positive right, negative left.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result has schemaVersion:1, status/operation/documentIdentity, associativity:nativeExpression, entities (offset child curve refs), constraint (native offset constraint ref), offsetParameter (native dimension parameter name for curve.offset-edit), before/after inspection and topologyChanged. status pass means the post-offset scan found no crossings or cusps; blocked means the offset was refused before mutation.

sections.title: Safety And Limits
sections.text: One connected loop per call. A kernel refusal can leave partial constraint/curves; inspect before retry, no rollback. Offsets of curvature-degenerate or intersecting input are blocked by the pre-mutation scan, which is sampled, not a global certificate.

examples.label: Outward circular offset
examples.requires: A real closed circle ref from sketch.inspect curves; the example token is a placeholder.
examples.output: result.entities is the outer child circle; result.offsetParameter names the native dimension (edit it with curve offset-edit).

sections.title: GM07 Offset Dimension Edit
sections.text: Edits the native offset dimension parameter of an existing offset by parameter name (for example d203, returned as offsetParameter by curve offset) or by a {token,name,kind:parameter} reference. The command verifies the parameter still drives an OffsetConstraint dimension, then writes the new length expression; the sign preserves the offset side.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result has schemaVersion:1, status:pass, operation, documentIdentity, units, frame:{space:sketch,sketch:Ref}, associativity:nativeExpression, parameter:{name,expression,unit,value}, before/after expressions, constraint:Ref and provenance:GM07. The new expression is retained by Fusion and may reference other parameters; child curves regenerate.

sections.title: Safety And Limits
sections.text: A deleted offset dimension cannot be edited; the command fails before any mutation. Editing can regenerate dependent features; no save or rollback is performed.

examples.label: Resize an existing offset
examples.requires: d203 must be the offsetParameter name reported by a previous curve offset in this document.
examples.output: result.after.expression is 8 mm and the offset child curves regenerate at the new distance.
